# Rana Bakery — Fresh Bakes on the Road to Rohtang

> A family-run bakery and cake shop in Bahang, Manali (Himachal Pradesh, India) since 1992. Everything is baked fresh every morning in small batches. Known for brownies, fresh cream pastries, eggless cakes, donuts, chocolate cakes, coconut macaroons and aloo patties. Also supplies wholesale to hotels, cafes and restaurants (HORECA) in the Manali area.

## Key facts
- Location: Bahang, Manali–Rohtang highway, Manali, Himachal Pradesh 175131, India (on the way to Solang Valley and Atal Tunnel)
- Established: 1992, family-run
- Hours: open daily, 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM
- Phone / WhatsApp orders: +91 83508 90419 (primary), +91 82198 85264 (backup)
- Price range: budget friendly (₹)
- Google rating: 4.6 stars

## Menu highlights
- Brownies (bestseller, dense and fudgy, baked fresh daily)
- Fresh cream pastries
- Eggless cakes (great for custom birthday orders)
- Donuts
- Chocolate cakes (birthday and celebration cakes, custom orders welcome)
- Coconut macaroons
- Aloo patties (savoury bestseller)
- Aata (whole wheat) bread, buns, cookies, coffee
